headline: KeyCorp (KEY) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Even After 110% Gains
summary: KeyCorp stock has delivered a 110.3% return over the past three years, while the current intrinsic value work using the Excess Returns model and the earnings multiples both suggest the shares trade at a discount to what the business may be worth. Taken together with a mixed overall value score, the question is how much weight to put on that apparent undervaluation. Over the last three years, KeyCorp has returned 110.3%.
